content:
Overview

jimmysong.io is a personal technical website maintained by Jimmy Song (rootsongjc@gmail.com). This page explains what information is collected when you visit and the third-party services in use. This site does not operate a user account system and does not ask you to submit personal information beyond what you choose to share.

Information We Collect

Server logs: The hosting provider may record standard request data (IP address, user agent, requested URL, timestamp) for security and abuse prevention. These logs are retained only as needed for operations.

Data you provide voluntarily: If you subscribe to the newsletter or leave a comment, the email address and comment content you enter are handled by the third-party services listed below.

Third-Party Services

This site uses the following third-party services. Each has its own privacy policy governing the data they collect:

Google Analytics: Collects only essential, aggregated visit information (such as page views, approximate region, device type, and referral source) to understand how content is used and to improve the site. IP anonymization is enabled. Data is processed by Google under its Privacy Policy. No ad personalization or cross-site tracking is performed.

Giscus: Comments are powered by Giscus, which uses GitHub. Comment data is stored in GitHub Discussions associated with the repository. See the Giscus Privacy Policy and GitHub Privacy Statement.

Cookies

Google Analytics sets first-party cookies to measure usage. This site does not use advertising cookies. You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings; blocking them affects traffic measurement only, not your ability to read the site.

Your Choices

Do not subscribe to the newsletter if you do not want your email stored by the mailing-list provider.

Avoid leaving a comment if you do not want it stored in GitHub Discussions.

Use your browser’s privacy or “Do Not Track” settings to limit third-party cookies.

Children’s Privacy

This site is directed at a general technical audience and is not intended for children under 13. No deliberate collection of children’s personal information occurs.

Changes

This policy may be updated. The lastmod date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.

Contact

Questions about this policy: rootsongjc@gmail.com.
